subject: Blueforge security review & demo scheduling
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martin <alex.martin@blueforge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Blueforge — security review + demo: timing for next week

Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation procurement and security want a joint session to cover: high-level architecture, data flow, retention controls, SOC 2 scope, and a short live demo of inference in a VPC-like setup.

Proposed structure: 60 min total (20m overview / 30m Q&A deep-dive / 10m next steps). Attendees we recommend: AE (me), SE (Monica/Karthik), Redwood Security (Mina), Blueforge engineering + procurement.

Can you confirm the primary stakeholders from your side and a few time windows next week that work for both procurement and engineering? We have open slots on 11/14 (afternoon) and 11/15 (mid-afternoon) PT.

I attached the initial security questionnaire you sent so we can align (Blueforge_SA_request.pdf).

Thanks —
Priya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri ya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Alex Martin <alex.martin@blueforge.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Blueforge — security review + demo: timing for next week

Priya —

Thanks — quick clarification. Procurement (Jordan) needs to approve commercial terms before we lock a tech deep-dive. They asked for a 30m procurement-only pre-call and then a technical session with security + engineers. Our team has an all-hands 11/14 morning, so afternoon works better for procurement, but there is some conflict with a board prep on 11/14 at 4pm PT.

Alternative: Can we look at 11/15 3:00–4:00pm PT for the combined session? If not possible, we may need to split into two shorter meetings: procurement (30m) + tech/security (60m) on separate days.

Attaching the SA request we referenced.

—Alex
Alex Martin
Senior Engineering Manager, Blueforge
alex.martin@blueforge.com | +1 206-555-0123

Alex / Jordan —

Appreciate the heads-up on constraints. We can do either:
- 11/15 3:00–4:00pm PT — combined 60m session (our preference), or
- Split: 11/14 4:00–4:30pm PT (procurement-only) + 11/16 10:00–11:00am PT (technical + security deep-dive).

Mina, what do you need from Blueforge to run an efficient 60m deep-dive vs. two sessions? If the customer can share a one-page system diagram and answers to the checklist ahead of time, Mina can run a focused 60m session. Otherwise she recommends 90m to get into architecture and controls.

HubSpot: I created a tentative record for the combined slot so procurement can link contract deadlines (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BLF-7890).

If procurement needs to see a commercial summary before their call, I can loop in sales ops.

Thanks — can you confirm the preferred path and I'll issue calendar holds?

—Priya

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Blueforge — security review + demo: timing for next week

Quick note on format from Security ops: we can run a concise 45–60m checklist-driven session if Blueforge provides a short architecture diagram and the completed checklist in advance. If Blueforge prefers an exploratory discussion with live infra diagrams and ACLs, we should reserve 90m.

Action items for Blueforge pre-call (suggested):
- One-page system diagram (PDF)
- Answers to the attached checklist (redwood-security-checklist.xlsx)
- Any required compliance artifacts (SOC 2 scope, encryption-at-rest details)

If you share those by EOD 11/14, we can do the combined 60m on 11/15 3:00–4:00pm PT. Otherwise recommend procurement-only 11/14 4:00–4:30pm PT and tech deep-dive 11/16 10:00–11:30am PT (90m) to avoid back-and-forth.

—Mina
Manager, Security Assurance | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.ai

Thanks — quick update from my side. Procurement (Jordan) just confirmed they need an approval conversation before EOD 11/15; the all-hands I mentioned is fixable but board prep is likely to push past 4pm on 11/14.

To keep timelines intact for our procurement deadlines, can we split into two short meetings:
1) Procurement-only: 11/14 4:15–4:45pm PT (30m) — commercial terms, contract path, procurement checklist.
2) Technical & Security: 11/16 10:00–11:00am PT (60m) — system diagram + controls + demo.

We can aim to get the system diagram and the completed checklist to you by EOD 11/14. If that happens, happy to collapse into the single 11/15 slot, but procurement needs the 11/14 touchpoint regardless to keep purchase timelines moving.

Alex
